description: Where modifiers are actually asked: one row per category↔modifier link, with that category’s own rules (required, min, max, order). This is what makes a modifier reach the till, so use it to answer "what options does this category ask" or "where is this modifier used". Narrow to one category with categoryId. Remember products also inherit their ancestors’ links, so a subcategory asks more than its own rows show. The id on each row is the LINK id — that is what update_category_modifier and unlink_modifier_from_category take.

categoryId.description: Category id from get_categories. Omit for every category
